newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli jets raid south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli jets raid south Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes made their 21st raid of the year on Lebanon on Wednesday, firing rockets at suspected guerrilla targets in the south Lebanon highlands, security sources said.

Two jets fired a total of four rockets into a valley near the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge which is controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrillas and lies just north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties or damage in the raid.

Hizbollah uses the rugged Iqlim al-Toufah to launch attacks on Israeli troops whom it is trying to drive from the 15-km (nine-miles) wide zone. The guerrillas have killed five Israeli soldiers this year.
The raid followed a meeting of a five-nation group monitoring a ceasefire in Lebanon which on Tuesday urged Israeli forces and Hizbollah to stay clear of civilian areas in their tit-for-tat war.
The monitoring group comprising the United States, France, Syria, Israel and Lebanon was formed under a U.S.-brokered agreement last April that ended a 17-day Israeli blitz on Lebanon.
The April agreement banned both sides from firing from or at civilian targets but does not restrict guerrilla attacks on Israeli troops in the occupation zone.
